verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure that is not tied to one model vendor. Its docs ship first-party integrations for Gemini Computer Use, Claude Computer Use and OpenAI Computer Use, plus framework integrations (Browser-Use, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, AgentKit, OpenAI Agents SDK, and Pydantic AI, described as "provider-agnostic"). This lets developers pair Steel browsers with the LLM provider of their choice. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party model-agnostic or bring-your-own-model statement for Steel itself, evidence of local or self-hosted model support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-provider use.
